scope: JevBench public subset only: 231 of 534 tasks (72 original, 48 easy, 111 hard). The private and judge tiers are unavailable; this is not a full-benchmark result.
selection_rule: trained conditions: the seed with the lowest final-epoch training loss for that (target, condition), ties to the lowest seed; untrained adapter: seed 0. Fixed in decision 0007 before evaluation; no JevBench answer or evaluation label is read.
